issues.problem: The derived priorities are written into the user's need_profile.json (also an interview_complete profile) as an ordinary weights_override. derive_critical_features returns {} whenever any weights_override exists and nothing reads weights_override_derived, so the machine-chosen Critical set is sticky: after the user fixes must_haves (as the gate message tells them) every later packaging still ranks on the old derived features, and the report presents them as the buyer's Critical rows. This also breaks dr_live_runner's contract that an existing need profile is never modified.
